indexStyle:
<style>
  /* page background image (kept behind content) */
  html::before{content:'';position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:-1;background-image:url('/images/bg.webp');background-size:cover;background-position:center center;background-repeat:no-repeat;opacity:0.95;}
  /* make main content wrappers transparent so the background shows through */
  body, .site, .container, .main, .content, .post-list, .post, .article, .post-item, .card, .post-card, .index-main {
    background-color: transparent !important;
  }
  /* style article cards and lists with a translucent backdrop for readability */
  .post, .post-item, .card, .post-card, .article, .list-item {
    background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72) !important;
    color: #111 !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px) saturate(120%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px) saturate(120%);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  }
  /* dark mode support */
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .post, .post-item, .card, .post-card, .article, .list-item {
      background-color: rgba(6,6,6,0.5) !important;
      color: #eee !important;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    }
  }
  /* ensure links and text remain readable */
  .post a, .article a { color: #1a73e8 !important; }
  /* disable any full-opaque overlays */
  .index-overlay, .home-bg-overlay, .bg-overlay { background-color: transparent !important; opacity: 1 !important; }
</style>
